metadata.evidence: # 3D CMR-Domain-Adaptation
metadata.reason: Identifies the repository/artifact by its title.

metadata.value: This repo contains code to train a deep learning model for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) of 3D cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) cine images to transform from axial to short-axis orientation.
metadata.normalized_value: This repo contains code to train a deep learning model for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA) of 3D cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) cine images to transform from axial to short-axis orientation.
metadata.evidence: This repo contains code to train a deep learning model for **Unsupervised Domain Adaptation (UDA)** of 3D cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) cine images to **transform from axial to short-axis orientation**.
metadata.reason: States the artifact's purpose and core functionality.

metadata.value: segmentation task via a pre-trained fixed network, leveraged to guide the transformation process (rigid transform via spatial transformer networks)
metadata.normalized_value: segmentation task via a pre-trained fixed network, leveraged to guide the transformation process (rigid transform via spatial transformer networks)
metadata.evidence: The task associated to the domain adaptation is to perform a **segmentation task via a pre-trained fixed network**, and the results are leveraged to guide the transformation process (rigid transform via spatial transformer networks).
metadata.reason: Describes the associated task and method used to guide domain adaptation.

metadata.value: Euler2Affine Layer to restrict the transform of the spatial transformer network to be rigid and invertible
metadata.normalized_value: Euler2Affine Layer to restrict the transform of the spatial transformer network to be rigid and invertible
metadata.evidence: A special **Euler2Affine Layer** was implemented to restrict the transform of the spatial transformer network to be rigid and invertible.
metadata.reason: Names a novel implemented layer, useful for understanding and reusing the method.
